name: 检测（无损/尺寸/探伤）方法

map.输入工件材料、厚度、缺陷类型与检测要求，自动推荐适合的无损检测方法（UT超声波/: Input workpiece material, thickness, defect type and inspection requirement to auto-recommend a suitable NDT method (UT ultrasound/RT radiography/MT magnetic particle/PT penetrant/ET eddy current) and give a comparison.
map.📖 查看「无损检测方法选择与评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "NDT Method Selection and Evaluation User Guide"
map.UT（超声波检测）：适用内部缺陷，可测厚，对粗糙表面敏感: UT (ultrasonic testing): for internal defects, can measure thickness, sensitive to rough surfaces
map.RT（射线检测）：适用内部缺陷，直观成像，但有辐射风险: RT (radiographic testing): for internal defects, intuitive imaging, but with radiation risk
map.MT（磁粉检测）：仅限铁磁性材料表面及近表面缺陷: MT (magnetic particle testing): only ferromagnetic materials, surface and near-surface defects
map.PT（渗透检测）：适用各种材料表面开口缺陷: PT (penetrant testing): for surface-breaking defects of any material
map.ET（涡流检测）：适用导电材料表面/近表面缺陷，可高速自动化: ET (eddy current testing): for surface/near-surface defects of conductive materials, high-speed automation
map.对比不同探伤设备灵敏度与检出概率。: Compare sensitivity and detection probability of different flaw-detection devices.
map.设备 A 可检出 ≥0.5mm 缺陷、设备 B ≥1.0mm：A 相对 B 灵敏: Device A detects defects >=0.5mm, device B >=1.0mm: A's sensitivity is 100% higher than B's (half threshold), more reliable for micro-cracks.
map.信号 80dB、噪声 60dB：信噪比 = 80−60 = 20dB，≥12dB: Signal 80dB, noise 60dB: SNR = 80-60 = 20dB; >=12dB generally identifies defects stably, below risks missed detection.
map.高灵敏度易检出微缺陷但误报增多、成本上升；按验收标准选合适阈值，兼顾检出率与效率: High sensitivity catches micro-defects but raises false alarms and cost; choose a threshold per acceptance standard, balancing detection rate and efficiency.
map.信噪比怎么影响探伤？: How does SNR affect flaw detection?
map.信噪比低时缺陷信号淹没在噪声中，需提高增益或滤波；过高增益会引入杂波，需平衡。: Low SNR drowns the defect signal in noise, needing higher gain or filtering; too-high gain introduces clutter, so balance is needed.
